This taxpayer is self-employed for both, so the federal deduction stands and no Schedule CA entry is made; the engine emits an info finding that the classification exception is not modeled. description: Single full-year California resident; one W-2 ($50,000 wages, $4,000 federal withholding, $1,500 California withholding) plus one 1099-NEC engagement ($20,000 compensation, $2,000 expenses, state withholding recorded explicitly as $0) — federal case 005's shape with California fields. Named for the Schedule CA question it settles: the federal deductible half of SE tax is NOT added back, because California conforms to IRC 164(f) for a taxpayer self-employed for both jurisdictions (2025 Instructions for Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section C, line 15 — the only difference there is an employee/contractor classification case, which subtracts, and v1 does not model it). California AGI therefore equals federal AGI, and the case owes $611 after the $1,500 withholding. Money values below are integer cents.
